approaches.code:
from collections import Counter
def solve(s):
    left=0; freq=Counter(); best=0
    for r,ch in enumerate(s):
        freq[ch]+=1
        while len(freq)>2:
            freq[s[left]]-=1
            if freq[s[left]]==0: del freq[s[left]]
            left+=1
        best=max(best,r-left+1)
    return best
